controls.label: CHF Solana mint authority
controls.capDescription: The verified current program permits the configured admin to change the daily limit and approve pending mints without a daily-limit recheck; the limit is not an immutable economic supply cap.
controls.evidence: Sol curation campaign 2026-10-09 (W2L27Newrails), observed 2026-10-09T11:43:28Z: one finalized getMultipleAccounts response at bank-context slot 454856255 binds the exact CHF mintAuthority to this MinterConfig, owned by issuer program 8CVKFptWa13Z43e82tYufueoWH7tqJfsNQXB33g1WeVw. getBlock for that slot gives hash F9jDR1JsLdZGzBsH55EcSMhcCe4ZhW81AUud14PowXnj, timestamp 1791546198 (2026-10-09T11:43:18Z). MinterConfig decodes to admin vault 2duhrjMfZdX1TX3sKzc9ZPkdJ1TtnXVgCYcxToTq3Kv9, pending_admin None, initiator 5CgAHs1K779jzqgB1K5kgTYozcexBGF9voi9zo2WCPMd and bump 255. ProgramData Gc8oYdqWg3PrgA7ioCXKY53vsB9vy6XHNWJyDcGaaWJe executable bytes after the 45-byte loader header, with trailing zero padding removed, hash to 0aff1fc23cc42369aacdcaf797d2579c691019c3170115b91116c3394f70a68d, exactly matching OSEc's independently verified issuer commit afdab14fb1a59bf3abe2f263870023349a560e2e (verification dated 2026-09-01T13:05:46.166083). Its set_daily_limit is admin-gated and adjustable; approve_mint mints the pending amount without rechecking MintDailyLimit. These are RPC-returned finalized-bank contextual observations, not historical-slot account queries. No complete Squads execution certificate, incident-free state, supply share, human independence or key-custody proof is asserted.

controls.label: CHF Solana minter program upgrade signer
controls.evidence: Sol curation campaign 2026-10-09 (W2L27Newrails), observed 2026-10-09T11:43:28Z: the same finalized bank-context slot 454856255 account response identifies the exact mint's authority PDA as issuer MinterConfig and its owning executable program 8CVKFptWa13Z43e82tYufueoWH7tqJfsNQXB33g1WeVw as BPFLoaderUpgradeable-owned. Its Program account points to ProgramData Gc8oYdqWg3PrgA7ioCXKY53vsB9vy6XHNWJyDcGaaWJe; ProgramData's loader state has deployment slot 443429864 and Some(upgrade_authority_address) equal to this signer, corroborating the immutable issuer deployment inventory. The signer is an on-curve public key with a system-owned zero-data account and is also the sole admin Squads member. Program replacement can replace the mint-critical code which signs as the existing MinterConfig PDA; the observed daily limit is therefore not an immutable supply cap. Block hash F9jDR1JsLdZGzBsH55EcSMhcCe4ZhW81AUud14PowXnj, timestamp 1791546198 (2026-10-09T11:43:18Z). This proves the local upgrade signer identity, not key custody, an incident-free history, complete execution-domain closure or a runtime liability share.

review.evidence: The October 9 substantive review adds the exact Solana minter executable/source match, adjustable admin cap and approval semantics, one-member admin Squads topology and the same member's direct program upgrade authority at finalized bank-context slot 454856255, block hash F9jDR1JsLdZGzBsH55EcSMhcCe4ZhW81AUud14PowXnj, timestamp 1791546198, observation 2026-10-09T11:43:28Z. It does not refresh the prior October 2/3 EVM, fund, custody or reconciliation observations. Five exact CHF EVM token requirement masks and chain-local ADMIN Safe signer/module reads establish observed direct-mint and upgrade controllers; their full permission-group census and guard/fallback/delay closure have not been independently established. The shared AMF-authorized SICAV/prospectus, CACEIS depositary and daily fund valuation, recurring fund reporting and named PwC appointment retain the previously reviewed prudential/periodic/unbounded-reconciled vocabulary, not a new independently signed CHF-token/all-register reconciliation or audit opinion. Starknet/Stellar operator and upgrade enumeration, the complete EVM permission-group roster, and EVM guard/fallback/delay observations remain unestablished. Solana Squads runtime/source parity and alternative execution-path closure remain unestablished despite the issuer minter's independently verified current byte hash. Independent key custody and signing policy remain unresolved. Native circulation exclusions and complete cross-register financial reconciliation remain unavailable in Backing.
